## Design

### 2026-10-06 — # Day 1! My first look at pcb design.

**2h**

# Day 1! My first look at pcb design.

I downloaded Kicad, as well as the default symbol and footprint libraries for my project (its a macropad with a joystick so i can avoid using wasd). They didnt come bundled with Kicad itself, which was annoying.

Downloading them was a pain. I  spent 45 minutes (not logged)
- removing files from my computer cuz it had no space
- crashing  out on  kicad when the default libraries i downloaded werent showing up
- went on a hunt through the internet on how to add libraries to kicad, then had to actually find those libraries
but in the end it worked out. Could I have done this faster? yes. Should I have done this yesterday? also yes lol. But did I do it? absolutely not because WE love procrastination.

I then spent about an hour learning how to use kicad from [this helpful tutorial series](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vaCVh2SAZY4&list=PL3bNyZYHcRSUhUXUt51W6nKvxx2ORvUQB)

![A picture of the thumbnail for the series](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/dd0f4b2d766256f151ff1edf64eb4ab068e22c4de963b102ed053386431809fe.png)

Then after about an hour 45  minutes of setup, i finally got started on the schematic :

![My schematic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/4ffd1e37b59c72d672bb84e05a79dabcd8d7882b06ffe15da3dfd4a4d9711e0b.png)

here i used an arduino leonardo instead of the arduino micro i am planning on using because they have the same pinout. (they do have a different footprint, but i can probably find a library for that, or worst case, edit it myself).

**tldr; i spent way too long doing setup that i should have done yesterday, and did a little work on my schematic lol**
